- [LLSU.16.4] **Capabilities.** [LCAP.1] registers every capability a
  program's `use` block may set; a name outside that registry is a compile
  error ([LDIA.3.3.2]). Testing is not among them — `.dstest` is a separate file type,
  not a capability ([LTES.7.6], [LTSL]). The imperative-shaped surface (activation
  timers, per-fact supersedure) sits in the base language per [LLSU.15.5].
